He recruits Chase for one last job, but things are about to spiral out of control.

programme.title: Just Can't Leave You Alone
programme.desc: When a blind date ends in a shootout, Krystal Gray is left with more questions than answers. She discovers a flash drive linked to the murder and a web of secrets involving her brother, a dirty cop, and a mysterious man named Jarrell. As she uncovers the truth, Krystal becomes the target in a deadly game where love and betrayal blur and everyone has a hidden agenda.

programme.title: Reality TV Murders
programme.desc: In the world of reality TV, Chasity Safire is a household name and has been the star of the hugely popular reality TV show “Diva’s Doing it” for the past 5 years. When one of the castmates is found dead, the women become suspects and we discover that some of the women would literally kill to be famous.

programme.title: The Laundry Room Stalker
programme.desc: A string of murders on local neighborhood sex workers have been occurring around one specific apartment building’s laundry room. But all suspicion points to the newly hired attendant, Calvin who was just released from prison for 12 years.

programme.title: You People
programme.desc: You People is a satirical comedy about modern stereotypes, chronicling the life of an intelligent, white-washed, African American college student, adopted by a liberal Caucasian family, who has a crisis of identity while growing up in the Bible belt, white suburbia with his urban hip-hop culture obsessed, white best friend. When an attractive girl on campus approaches the black protagonist based on his 'presumed' stereotypical traits, he has to undergo a 'cultural transformation' with the help of his white companion to tap into his inner 'blackness.'

programme.title: The Break of Dawn
programme.desc: After leaving an abusive relationship, college student Dawn Monae discovers that her ex has committed suicide. After some time, she meets a man named Keith online, but her roommates suspect that he isn’t who he says he is. Little do they know, he has an agenda that no one saw coming.

programme.title: Murder on the Pole
programme.desc: One night Bunny was the queen of the dance floor; the next, she was a chalk outline. Dismissed by a department eager to sweep a "club girl's" death under the rug, Lola refuses to let her sister’s killer walk free. To find the murderer, Lola must infiltrate the world that claimed Bunny’s life—a world of predatory regulars, backstage betrayals, and a cover-up that goes higher than she ever imagined.

programme.title: Love Kills
programme.desc: In the heart of Atlanta's unpredictable dating scene, Darron is a hopeless romantic with the worst luck imaginable. Every time he believes he's found "the one," he ends up caught in another tangled web of passion, betrayal, and danger. When Darron finally meets someone who seems genuine, his past mistakes come back with a vengeance. One of his exes' jealous boyfriends discovers their hidden affair, setting off a chain of events that spirals out of control.

programme.title: Transcend
programme.desc: Maranda spent her life looking for a protector, only to find herself lost in a cycle of toxic love and betrayal. From the wreckage of abandonment to a life-altering crossroads, her survival isn't just about escaping the past, it’s about surviving herself.

Despite his app's mission, he struggles with love, further complicated by a child support order. A night out leads him to Sierra, an alluring actress who quickly moves in. Their romance sours as Sierra's past as a dancer and her aggressive jealousy come to light.

programme.title: Taboo 2

Mills decides to investigate Alex Johnstone, even after being told by his supervisor not to do so. Mills convinces Smith that they must find the evidence that connects Alex Johnstone to the missing woman before he tracks them down.

programme.title: National Collegiate Pickleball Association (NCPA)
programme.desc: We are live from the Barnes Tennis Center in San Diego, California, for Week 3 of the NCPA San Diego Regional 2025. This thrilling collegiate team match features Grand Canyon University (GCU) taking on the University of Hawaii. The broadcast picks up in the heat of the action during a crucial mixed doubles game, with GCU leading. Watch as the match extends into a dramatic Sudden Death Dreambreaker (Game 7) to decide the winner. The episode highlights the unique collegiate format where every point counts towards seeding for the National Championship. Key players include Hawaii's Tristan Simmons and Tama, battling against GCU's Tanner and Hannah. The match concludes with a high-stakes finish that determines who moves forward in bracket play.

programme.title: National Collegiate Pickleball Association (NCPA)
programme.desc: Live from the NCPA Indiana Regional 2025, watch a thrilling collegiate pickleball battle between Purdue University and Creighton University. Later, Purdue’s Caleb Young and Tammy Lamb take on Creighton’s Noah Wodzinski and Elizabeth Cook.

programme.title: National Collegiate Pickleball Association (NCPA)
programme.desc: We are live in sunny San Diego for Week 3 of the NCPA San Diego Regional 2025. This high-stakes collegiate team match features the University of San Diego (USD) battling Grand Canyon University (GCU) in a best-of-seven series.The action includes intense Men's Doubles , Women's Singles , and Mixed Doubles as these teams compete for regional dominance. Watch top talent, including GCU's lefty powerhouse Adam Jones, who boasts a strong 5.6 singles rating , and his partner Xavier Cook Nakakuki. On the USD side, the episode highlights the partnership of Marcus Hopkins and Ryan, an impressive grad student player with high doubles ratings. USD’s Bella also shows grit in the women's singles match. This broadcast captures the best of college pickleball in an amazing format.

programme.title: US Open Pickleball Championships 2025

programme.title: World Pickleball League (WPBL)
programme.desc: Experience the electric atmosphere of the World Pickleball League (WPBL) Season 2 as the Mumbai Pickle Power face off against the Bengaluru Jawans in a high-stakes Tie 9. With Mumbai hunting for their first outright victory and Bengaluru desperate to bounce back from a recent loss, the pressure at the Jio World Garden is at an all-time high. Watch as elite players like the "unstoppable" Katrina Stewart dominate the court in singles, while Brandon Lane and Glaura Carvajal Lane attempt to turn the tide for Mumbai in a masterclass of tactical doubles. This tie features the league’s most innovative strategies, from high-risk Pickle Plays to the pursuit of the prestigious Band of Honor, ensuring every rally is a battle for survival on the road to the semi-finals.

programme.title: National Collegiate Pickleball Association (NCPA)
programme.desc: Welcome to Week 3, Day 1 of the NCPA San Diego Regional 2025, live from the Barnes Tennis Center in the heart of San Diego, California. This highly anticipated state rivalry pits the UCLA Bruins against the SDSU Aztecs in a crucial best-of-seven collegiate team match.The match format prioritizes singles, with UCLA winning the coin toss and opting to start with Women's Singles. The broadcast features the Women's Singles match between Mae Lee (UCLA) and Emily Miller (SDSU), and the Men's Singles where SDSU's Preston Lynch takes a commanding early lead. The match also includes Gender Doubles, where SDSU (the Aztecs) took an early 3-0 lead in the overall match score. The winner of this pool play match gains a strong position for seeding, moving closer to securing one of the National Championship bids.

programme.title: DUPR Collegiate National Championship
programme.desc: Witness a high-stakes semifinal showdown at the 2025 DUPR Collegiate National Championships as the Texas Longhorns take on the Grand Canyon University Antelopes. The "Racing" tempo of the match is fueled by a relentless GCU crowd that puts immense pressure on Texas stars like Zoya Khan and Natalie Loo. With the defending champions already sidelined, both teams showcase "Freestyle" grit and creativity in a battle to crown a brand-new national champion.

programme.title: Mataron a Valladares
programme.desc: Los respetados Valladares, arraigados a tradiciones ven su mundo desmoronarse cuando el hijo mayor emigra a EE. UU. Tragedias y traiciones revelan un destino implacable desafiando sus valores y uniendo a la familia en una dolorosa realidad.

programme.title: La Hermana del Traficante
programme.desc: Familia de narcotraficantes controla una importante plaza de una ciudad del norte. Luego de muchos enfrentamientos con bandas rivales y policías, ahora la ambición de de cada uno de ellos ocasiona una guerra interna familiar por el control total.

programme.title: Coyotes de La Frontera
programme.desc: A lo largo de la frontera con México, el policía corrupto El Comandante Santos colabora con un líder de una pandilla para contrabandear migrantes, exponiendo la corrupción profundamente arraigada y la desesperación de quienes buscan una vida mejor.

programme.title: Scarface Renacido
programme.desc: Para ser un grande en la mafia, tienes que tener el mejor escolta. Este es el trabajo del Comandante Antrax, quien apoyado por un comando de calaveras se encarga de eliminar las lacras.

programme.title: Cárteles Unidos
programme.desc: El gobierno ha declarado la guerra a todos los cárteles del país. La consigna es acabar con el crimen organizado. Organizaciones criminales que se disputan territorios clave y defienden los propios a sangre y fuego.

programme.title: Mataron a Valladares
programme.desc: Los respetados Valladares, arraigados a tradiciones ven su mundo desmoronarse cuando el hijo mayor emigra a EE. UU. Tragedias y traiciones revelan un destino implacable desafiando sus valores y uniendo a la familia en una dolorosa realidad.

programme.title: El Plebe Chakaloso 2
programme.desc: El famoso '25' está de regreso y con su llegada inicia una guerra salvaje y sangrienta contra El Texano por el control del territorio.

programme.title: Le Firmé Un Contrato Al Diablo
programme.desc: Damián, un misterioso personaje, moverá sus fichas en carteles enemigos, causando confrontación entre ellos. Muerte y destrucción será el destino para todo el que cruce las calles sangrientas.

programme.title: Andabas de Perro
programme.desc: Rodrigo y Gitano, criados como hermanos, trabajan con el mismo jefe criminal. Todo cambia cuando Rodrigo, apoyado por el "Faisán", traiciona a Gitano, desatando una cacería sangrienta. La rivalidad los lleva a una violenta lucha hasta que uno muera.

programme.title: Me Apodan Calibre 45
programme.desc: Temido por todos, este individuo letal persigue enemigos con determinación. Con pasado turbulento y habilidades excepcionales, enfrenta desafíos mortales, determinado a resolver un asunto pendiente que lo hace invencible hasta la muerte.

programme.title: Hay 500 Mil Dólares de Recompensa
programme.desc: El Comandante Emilio está encargado de un pueblo en el desierto, el esta detrás del Narcotraficante llamado El Faraón, cuando el procurador del pueblo decide despedir al Comandante Emilio, por golpear a un hombre que estaba maltratando a su esposa, toma la oportunidad El Faraón de eliminar a su enemigo de una vez.

programme.title: El Plebe Chakaloso 2
programme.desc: El famoso '25' está de regreso y con su llegada inicia una guerra salvaje y sangrienta contra El Texano por el control del territorio.

programme.desc: Damián, un misterioso personaje, moverá sus fichas en carteles enemigos, causando confrontación entre ellos. Muerte y destrucción será el destino para todo el que cruce las calles sangrientas.

programme.title: Asfixia
programme.desc: Despues de salir de prision, donde aprendio a cuidar enfermos, Alma, una mujer albina, está decidida a recuperar algo mucho más importante que su propia libertad.

programme.title: Brujas del Cordobazo
programme.desc: El Cordobazo fue una manifestacion popular que significo un impulso fundamental para la sociedad argentina

programme.title: Brujas del Cordobazo
programme.desc: El Cordobazo fue una manifestacion popular que significo un impulso fundamental para la sociedad argentina

programme.title: EL LLAMADO DEL AGUA
programme.desc: La gente se esta organizando para generar conciencia sobre el uso del agua tras sufrir los incendios masivos que devastaron el bosque.

programme.title: Ros de Ceniza
programme.desc: Esteban ends his life when he jumps from a bridge towards a water dam that transports him into a dreamlike universe. There he begins a purgatory journey where he must face his insecurities and the condemnation of living under the command of his father, a despotic hierarch who rules over the family.

programme.title: EL REINO DE DIOS
programme.desc: Neimar quiere sentir la presencia de Dios, si tan solo pudiera descubrir como. Mientras tanto, busca una felicidad que entra en conflicto con las complejidades de la vida real.

programme.title: Amalia
programme.desc: CRISTINA, de 43 anos, atraviesa un embarazo de alto riesgo y vive una noche de tragedia cuando se entera de que una explosion ha afectado el lugar donde se cree que está su hija adolescente, AMALIA. Espera… con algo más que fe.

programme.title: El Grito Del Suquia
programme.desc: Emprendemos un recorrido en bote de 32 km, que nos permite conectar con experiencias de vida sobre diversas realidades socioambientales ligadas al rio Suquia en cada parada.

programme.title: CRONICAS CHILANGAS
programme.desc: La confusion y la excentricidad son parte de la vida en el vasto oceano humano de la Ciudad de Mexico.

programme.title: DIAS BORROSOS
programme.desc: Emilia, contemplando la maternidad en un mundo pospandemico, forma una conexion inesperada con su deprimido vecino anciano, Felipe.

programme.title: HUACHICOLERO
programme.desc: Lalo es un adolescente de catorce años que, desde una vision ingenua, se involucra en el mundo clandestino del robo de gas al intentar conseguir dinero para comprarle un regalo a Ana y ganarse su corazon.

programme.title: DOS ORIENTALES
programme.desc: Dos Orientales recorren el mundo con musica, recuerdos y alegria.

programme.title: Aurora Boreal (Mi Ultimo d¡a)
programme.desc: Mexico, 1994. Mariano, un adolescente atormentado, ha decidido quitarse la vida… pero no sin antes grabar un testimonio en video para explicarle al mundo las razones detrás de su decision.

programme.title: Brujas del Cordobazo
programme.desc: El Cordobazo fue una manifestacion popular que significo un impulso fundamental para la sociedad argentina

programme.title: Bruma
programme.desc: Martina queda embarazada de su novio egoista. Sin saber exactamente que hacer, viaja a Berlin para buscar a su padre, a quien nunca conocio.

programme.title: JAGUAR VOZ DE UN TERRITORIO
programme.desc: Es un recorrido por montañas, selvas y llanuras donde el jaguar ha tenido una relacion directa con los seres humanos.

programme.title: JUEGOS DE LA VIDA
programme.desc: Javier, un adolescente egoista, cambia tras un accidente. Una historia de amor, amistad y reflexion sobre lo esencial de la vida.

programme.title: KIMURA
programme.desc: Armando Carrera, un exluchador con un pasado tragico, regresa a Panama en busca del perdon de su hermano Alejandro.
